The Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association's information desk will be closed on Saturday, March 21, 2026 (Reiwa 8) due to scheduled facility maintenance at Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry. All information services, including phone support, will be unavailable. We will not be able to sell Eagle Bus passes, distribute manhole cards, or hand out prizes for the mystery-solving campaign and yellow week digital stamp rally.

However, on Saturday, March 21 only, Plat Hanno (Hanno Station Tourist Information Center) will remain open to assist you.

The main office will resume normal operations on Friday, March 20 (national holiday) and Sunday, March 22. Plat Hanno and Yumeba will operate normally throughout.
summary: ℹ️ Tourist Information Desk Closure Notice
